Description

We are privileged at Waltham St Lawrence Cricket club to have a wealth of excellent facilities at our disposal. Whether it be just our spacious grounds in an idyllic setting or our lively clubhouse with bar and lounge areas including indoor sports facilities, you will find our facilities both affordable and of the highest quality. Have a look at our price list below and also check out the photo gallery.

We are perfect for birthdays, christenings and children’s parties too so if you would like to come and have a look around, get in touch and our Club Manager will be happy to give you a tour.
